brief_rationale: The doctor systematically addressed all seven responsibility-chain items without missing a single serious duty. Postoperative red flags, the pathology loop, a concrete follow-up plan with owner and timing, gap management, comorbidity medication boundaries, adherence minimum steps, and non-overreach were each explicitly handled. All four high-order test points were triggered and completed with meaningful trajectory impact, including navigating refusal, correcting misconceptions, discovering hidden records, and delivering a bounded open-thread closure. No in-chain error, important non-chain defect, or safety omission is present. The trajectory satisfies Perfect grade requirements.
